messages:
erin (Docs): Quick sync: partner reported inconsistent terminology across migration docs and missing a short accessible SDK example. Want a small, final pass on voice + glossary wording.
samir (Eng): I can add a tiny snippet that returns plain_text and structured bullets. Keeps it easy for screen readers.
lucy (Product): Product rule: when referring to the product offering use Title Case (Hosted, Dedicated, Private). Use 'Redwood' for capability statements; 'we' ok in procedural steps. Add to style guide.
owen (DevEx): I'll add a light CI check to flag 'we' on product landing pages and Title Case misuse. Low false positives.
nina (Legal): Please avoid absolutes like "fully isolated" or "100% private". Use "designed to" or "intended to". I'll review glossary.
erin (Docs): Action items: (1) update docs/style/voice.md with three rules + two quick examples, (2) insert JS/Python snippet under docs/examples/accessibility.md, (3) sweep glossary entries for Private/Dedicated/Hosted phrasing. Volunteers?
samir (Eng): I'll push JS + Python examples. JS sample: ```js
// accessible pattern
const resp = await redwood.generate({ model: 'rw-1-large', input: 'Summarize as short bullets', format: 'json' });
console.log(resp.plain_text); // TTS/screen reader
console.log(resp.structured?.bullets || []); // keyboard nav
```
erin (Docs): Nice. I'll open the style PR and tag Legal for glossary review. Targeting PRs by Thu EOD.
docbot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/531 (erin)
lucy (Product): For migration guides add a "voice note" snippet at the top showing Hosted vs Private phrasing so reviewers know what to change.
erin (Docs): Good call. I'll include that. If anyone spots awkward wording in the migration guides, drop file paths here and I'll batch-fix. :thumbsup)
_meta: dataset-gen: docs voice/terminology alignment thread with accessible SDK snippet and linter plan
